description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Value', which is a subtype of 'Image_Graph_Marker'. It implements a marker that displays a data value on a graph, with functionalities to set background styles, preprocess data, and render text markers on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
classes.description: A marker showing the data value, which displays a box with the data point's value, formatted according to a specified preprocessing step.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the marker with the specified value type (X, Y, percentage, etc.) and sets default styles.

methods.name: setBackground
methods.description: Sets the background fill style of the marker element.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the marker element.

methods.name: setDataPreprocessor
methods.description: Assigns a data preprocessor for formatting the display value.

methods.name: _getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value to display based on the specified value type and data point.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Handles rendering the marker box with the value text at specified coordinates.
